description: This file is a PHP class defining an administrative controller ('GlossarySubController') for managing glossary entries in the Goteo project. It includes methods for CRUD operations and permission checks related to glossary terms.

classes.name: Goteo\Controller\Admin\GlossarySubController
classes.description: A controller class for managing glossary terms in the administrative interface, providing CRUD operations, permission checks, and translation functionalities.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user has necessary permissions (superadmin or root) on the specified node.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles translation-related requests for glossary terms.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the creation of new glossary entries.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays the list of glossary terms.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Core method to process add, edit, remove, or list actions, including handling form submissions and saving data.
